text:
sylvia: ACME asked if we can offer an "elastic burst shim" for Dedicated pools — basically a short-lived headroom that eases short spikes without touching contracted quota. Can we scope an MVP?

hao: Define "short-lived" and the invariants: does shim consume reserved capacity or live as a temporary buffer? Also needs clear billing semantics.

jeff: Proposal: shim = pool-local ephemeral buffer (not charged against committed quota) that lasts up to 20s per burst and only for requests <= 800 tokens. If used, we record `shim_consumed` and charge a premium rate on those tokens.

jeff: config sketch:
```yaml
pool_shim:
  enabled: true
  ttl_s: 20
  token_cap: 800
  charge_tier: premium
```

lina: Product asks: 1) customer-visible toggle (opt-in per-tenant) 2) console shows daily shim usage + projected cost 3) launch criteria: ACME pilot + p95 latency for shimmed requests within 1.5x baseline.

finance-bot: finance: premium billing OK but must emit `shim_charge` events with fields: tenant_id, tokens, billed_rate. Need nightly reconciliation and optional invoice line item.

hao: Ops: must be pool-local only to avoid cross-tenant contagion. Runtime options: a) preallocate small JVM/GPU slots for shim variants, or b) fast-route to quantized prewarmed workers in same pool. Prefer (b) to avoid memory swaps. Add guard: disable shim if pool_shim_rate > 2% sustained.

ops-bot: monitor-bot: alert `shim_overuse` when pool_shim_consumption > 5% of pool for 10m.

jeff: UX note: customers should see cost estimate before enabling. Also allow opt-out to always bill at committed rates (no shim).

lina: For launch acceptance: - pilot with ACME and 2 internal tenants for 10 days - automated similarity checks on demoted outputs if we route to smaller models - load test showing no more than 5% extra latency at p95 on pool under typical load - billing events emitted and reconciled

hao: Implementation checklist: - API flag `pool_shim_v1` (tenant opt-in) - runtime route to prewarmed quantized workers in pool - telemetry: `shim_accepts`, `shim_tokens`, `shim_latency` - ops circuit: backoff when `shim_overuse` fires - finance: `shim_charge` event + nightly job - docs + customer opt-out text

jeff: Risk note: premium billing might encourage tenants to abuse shim. Add per-tenant weekly cap and require explicit approval above threshold.

lina: Prioritization: medium-high for Dedicated roadmap Q4. If ACME signs pilot, bump to top of next sprint.

finance-bot: finance: also want a test invoice sample in pilot so customers see line item before GA.

sylvia: OK next steps: hao + jeff to write short RFC with config and failure modes; lina to draft pilot acceptance template and customer copy; finance to prepare reconciliation ticket. Friday 11am to align.

jeff: I'll include memory/prewarm numbers and a simple circuit backoff in the RFC.

sylvia: Thanks all :rocket:
